gizmo.title: Kutanga mudziyo wekunze
gizmo.description: Bhuroko rinovhura mudziyo wekudzidza wekunze muhwindo idzva kana papeji, se link yakapusa kana nechikumbiro chekupinda cheLTI 1.3.

configure.title: Tsananguro
configure.description: Zvinoitwa nevadzidzi mumudziyo, zvinoratidzwa pamusoro pebhatani.

configure.title: URL yekutanga
configure.description: Kero yemudziyo. Inofanira kuva kero yakazara inotanga ne https:// kana http://.

configure.title: Vhura mu
configure.description: Hwindo idzva rinoshanda nemudziyo wese. Papeji iri rinoshanda chete nemidziyo inobvumira kuratidzwa mukati meimwe saiti.

advanced.title: URL yekupinda yeLTI
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 chete: kero yekutanga kupinda yemudziyo. Nayo, client ID ne deployment ID bhatani rinotumira chikumbiro chekupinda cheLTI panzvimbo pekuvhura link yakapusa. Kupedzisa kutanga kunoda sevhisi yeLTI yesaiti iyi.

advanced.title: LTI client ID
advanced.description: Client ID yakapihwa saiti iyi nemudziyo. Chiziviso cheruzhinji, kwete chakavanzika: usambofa wakaisa makiyi kana zvakavanzika pano.

advanced.title: LTI deployment ID
advanced.description: Deployment ID yakapihwa saiti iyi nemudziyo. Chiziviso cheruzhinji, kwete chakavanzika.

advanced.title: LTI issuer
advanced.description: Kero inozivisa saiti iyi kumudziyo. Siya pasina chinhu kuti ushandise kero yesaiti iripo peji.

advanced.title: Kureba papeji
advanced.description: Kureba kwemudziyo kana wavhurika papeji iri, mumapixel (200 kusvika 2000).

advanced.title: Ruvara rwekusimbisa
advanced.description: Ruvara rwechip yemusoro nebhatani. Siya pasina chinhu kuti utevere theme.

developer.title: Chiratidzo chekupinda cheLTI
developer.description: Kukosha kusinganzwisisike kunoshandiswa nesevhisi yeLTI yesaiti iyi kuziva mudzidzi. Kazhinji kunopihwa nesaiti kuburikidza nechiitiko che lti-launch-request pane kuchengetedzwa pano. Haisi pasiwedhi kana kiyi.

developer.title: Chiratidzo chemeseji cheLTI
developer.description: Kukosha kusinganzwisisike kunoshandiswa nesevhisi yeLTI yesaiti iyi kuziva kutanga uku. Kazhinji kunopihwa nesaiti pane kuchengetedzwa pano.
